items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: Arthur Wing? Arthur Wing. Yeah, I don't know him. He died.

ctx.x: What about the Astoria? Yeah, that seems okay. What about the MC? Do you have an MC? Yeah. What would that be? Arthur Wing. Arthur Wing? Arthur Wing. Yeah, I don't know him. He died. Oh, yeah. But what would the MC do?
No, not to that accent or that shit, you know. Yeah. Would they ever make any jokes? Huh?
